title: neostapfia colusana
intro: Neostapfia colusana, commonly known as the Colusana rush, is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). The Colusana rush has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe irritated tissues, acting as an anti-inflammatory and expectorant. The bioactive constituents of Neostapfia colusana have been identified as saponins and phenolic compounds, contributing to its medicinal properties.
